common_causes.label: Vacuum leak (intake manifold, hoses, brake booster)

characteristic_signatures.vacuum_leak: Short/long fuel trims rise steadily with engine load and stay high; MAF reads a smooth but consistently LOW offset (~10-15%) versus rpm-derived expected airflow; O2 leans out as load rises.
characteristic_signatures.maf_fault: MAF reading erratic, stuck, or wildly inconsistent with rpm/load; fuel trim error scales with the MAF error itself.
characteristic_signatures.weak_fuel_delivery: Trims go NEGATIVE at high load (ECU can't add enough fuel under demand) or fuel pressure drops under load; lean at WOT.
characteristic_signatures.ignition_fault: Misfires present but fuel trims remain near normal (<±8%); misfire often cylinder-specific rather than random across all cylinders.
characteristic_signatures.o2_sensor_fault: O2 voltage flatlined near 0V or railed near 1V with no switching while fuel trims show active closed-loop correction.
